n. 化合物；複合物；院落
adj. 複合的；合成的；複利的
example: An old knee injury compounded his financial troubles, since he could not work for several months. (舊膝傷使他的財務困境雪上加霜，因為他有好幾個月無法工作。)

meaning: n. 部分；片段；區段
example: This segment of the documentary focuses on small fishing families, whose daily lives changed after the harbour closed. (這段紀錄片聚焦小型漁業家庭；港口關閉後，他們的日常生活因此改變。)

meaning: adv. 偶爾；有時
example: We occasionally hear owls at night, but we have never seen them. (我們偶爾在夜裡聽見貓頭鷹叫，但從來沒有看過牠們。)

meaning:
v. 旋轉；自轉；紡線
n. 旋轉；自旋；兜風
example: The distant planet spins rapidly on its axis, completing a full turn roughly every twenty-four hours. (那顆遙遠的行星繞著自己的軸快速自轉，大約每二十四小時轉完一圈。)

meaning:
n. 沙漠；荒地
adj. 無人居住的；荒涼的
v. 拋棄；離棄；擅離
example: Crossing the desert by bus takes two days, so travellers are advised to carry far more water than usual. (搭巴士穿越沙漠需要兩天，因此建議旅客攜帶比平常多得多的水。)

meaning:
vt. 提倡；主張；支持
n. 倡議者；支持者；辯護律師
example: She advocates walking to school instead of driving such a short distance. (她提倡步行上學，而不是為這麼短的距離開車。)

meaning: n. 浴缸；洗澡；沐浴
example: She ran a deep hot bath and left the bathroom door slightly open. (她放了滿滿一缸熱水，並把浴室門稍微留著一道縫。)

meaning: adj. 失明的；盲目的；未加思考的
example: The charity trains guide dogs for people who are blind or partially sighted. (這個慈善機構為失明或視力不佳的人訓練導盲犬。)

meaning: vt. 克服；戰勝；使受不了
example: The team overcame several serious obstacles, including a broken old pump and two days of continuous heavy rain. (這個團隊克服了幾項嚴重障礙，包括一台故障的舊水泵和連續兩天的大雨。)

meaning: adv. 短暫地；簡短地；簡要地
example: The lights flickered briefly before the whole street went dark, and curious neighbours came outside. (整條街陷入黑暗前，燈光短暫閃爍了一下，好奇的鄰居們走到屋外。)

meaning:
n. 法律顧問；忠告；諮詢
v. 勸告；建議；提供法律意見
example: She sought legal counsel before signing the three-year rental agreement. (她在簽署三年租約前先尋求法律諮詢。)

meaning: v. 打擾；使不安
example: The constant drilling disturbed the neighbours so much that two families eventually moved out. (持續不斷的鑽孔聲嚴重打擾鄰居，最後有兩戶人家搬走了。)

meaning: adj. 安靜的；沉默的
example: The whole room fell silent when the manager entered with the final results. (經理帶著最終結果走進來時，整個房間頓時安靜下來。)

meaning:
n. 負擔；重擔
v. 使負擔沉重；煩擾
example: The cost of care can be a heavy financial burden for families caring for elderly relatives. (照護費用可能成為照顧年長親屬的家庭沉重的經濟負擔。)

meaning: v. 運作；表現；舉止
example: The software behaves differently depending on the age of the device used. (這套軟體會依使用裝置的新舊而有不同的運作方式。)

meaning:
v. 利用；開發（資源）
n. 輕敲；水龍頭
example: The company hopes to tap into the skills of retired engineers living in the area. (這家公司希望善用住在當地的退休工程師的專業技能。)

meaning: n. 山谷；谷地
example: The valley floods every spring, depositing rich soil across the surrounding farmland. (這座山谷每年春天都會氾濫，為周圍農地沉積肥沃的土壤。)

meaning:
n. 警報；驚恐
vt. 使驚慌；使擔憂
example: The bank's alarm sounded loudly at midnight, but police eventually found only a small frightened cat trapped inside. (銀行的警報在午夜大響，但警方最後只發現一隻受困在裡面的驚恐小貓。)

meaning: adj. 極好的；了不起的
example: The view from the hotel room was fantastic, although the service was disappointing. (飯店房間的景觀極好，不過服務令人失望。)

meaning: n. 偏好；喜愛
example: Given the choice, most passengers showed a clear preference for the window seats. (如果可以選擇，多數乘客明顯偏好靠窗的座位。)

meaning: n. 發現；發現的事物
example: The discovery of antibiotics changed medicine more than almost any other advance. (抗生素的發現對醫學的改變，幾乎勝過任何其他進展。)

meaning: n. 裙子；裙裝
example: She chose a dark skirt and a simple blouse for the interview. (她選了一條深色裙子和一件簡單的襯衫去面試。)

meaning: adj. 東方的；東部的
example: Eastern parts of the city have better transport links than the western suburbs. (這座城市東部的交通連結比西部郊區好。)

meaning: n. 香菸
example: He stepped outside to smoke a cigarette before the long meeting resumed. (漫長的會議繼續前，他走到外面抽了一根香菸。)

meaning: n. 貧窮；貧困
example: Growing up in poverty can affect a child's long-term health and education. (在貧窮中長大可能影響孩子長期的健康和教育。)

meaning: n. 登記；掛號；註冊
example: Registration at the new clinic usually opens at eight, and patients without an appointment must wait patiently outside. (新診所通常八點開始掛號，沒有預約的病人必須在外面耐心等候。)

meaning: n. 堂／表兄弟姊妹；堂／表親
example: My favourite cousin lives in Canada and usually visits us every other summer. (我最要好的表親住在加拿大，通常每隔一個夏天來看我們。)

meaning: n. 碗；一碗的量
example: She filled a bowl with hot soup and carried it carefully to the table. (她盛了一碗熱湯，小心地端到桌上。)

meaning: n. 條款；子句
example: The contract contains a clause allowing either side to end the agreement early. (合約中有一項條款，允許任何一方提前終止協議。)

meaning:
vt. 使留下深刻印象；使欽佩
n. 印記；印象
example: The student impressed the interviewers with her clear, calm answers despite having little practical work experience. (這名學生以清晰、沉著的回答打動面試官，儘管她幾乎沒有實務工作經驗。)

meaning: n. 陪審團；評審團
example: The jury took two full days to reach a unanimous verdict of not guilty. (陪審團花了整整兩天才一致裁定無罪。)

meaning:
n. 冒險事業；創業項目
v. 冒險前往；冒險做
example: The farm shop began as a small venture run by two sisters. (這家農場商店原本是兩姊妹經營的小型事業。)

meaning: n. 病毒；電腦病毒
example: The virus spreads through close personal contact and can survive on surfaces. (這種病毒透過密切的個人接觸傳播，還能在物體表面存活。)

meaning: n. 焦慮；擔憂
example: Her anxiety about the exam made it difficult to sleep the night before. (她對考試的焦慮，讓她在考前一晚很難入睡。)

meaning:
v. 包裹；包紮；裹住
n. 披肩；外套；包裹物
example: Wrap each glass in newspaper before placing them in the cardboard box. (把每個玻璃杯用報紙包起來，再放進紙箱。)

meaning: adj. 非法的；違法的
example: Illegal film downloads are common, but they still damage smaller studios that cannot absorb sudden losses. (非法下載電影很常見，但這種行為仍會傷害無法承受突發損失的小型片廠。)

meaning:
adj. 海外的；外國的
adv. 在海外；到海外
example: The company rapidly expanded into new overseas markets, which brought fresh income but also several unfamiliar legal risks. (公司迅速拓展新的海外市場，帶來新收入，卻也帶來幾項陌生的法律風險。)

meaning: n. 青少年；十幾歲的人
example: Many teenagers spend several hours a day looking at screens for entertainment rather than study. (許多青少年每天花好幾小時看螢幕娛樂，而不是讀書。)

meaning: v. 專攻；專門從事
example: The clinic specialises in treating sports injuries and long-term back pain in adults. (這家診所專攻成人運動傷害與長期背痛的治療。)

meaning:
adj. 適度的；中等的；溫和的
v. 使緩和；主持（討論）
example: Moderate exercise three times a week can significantly lower your blood pressure. (每週三次適度運動可以顯著降低血壓。)

meaning: n. 限制；局限；缺點
example: A serious limitation of the small camera is its poor performance in low light, especially indoors. (這台小相機的一項重大限制，是在低光源環境下表現不佳，尤其是在室內。)

meaning: vt. 修改；調整
example: Engineers modified the design after tests showed the bridge could vibrate badly. (測試顯示橋梁可能劇烈震動後，工程師修改了設計。)

meaning: adj. 準確的；精確的
example: Weather models have become accurate enough to warn farmers a week before a heatwave. (天氣模型已準確到能在熱浪來臨前一週提醒農民。)

meaning: n. 胸部；胸腔；箱子；五斗櫃
example: The old wooden chest of drawers belonged to her grandmother, so she quietly but firmly refused to sell it. (這個舊木製五斗櫃屬於她祖母，因此她低調但堅決地拒絕出售。)

meaning:
n. 角度；觀點；角落
v. 使傾斜；斜向移動
example: Try viewing the problem from a different angle before making a decision. (做決定前，試著從不同角度看待這個問題。)

meaning: adj. 全面的；綜合的
example: They chose a comprehensive insurance policy, although it cost almost twice as much as basic cover. (他們選擇了全面的保險方案，儘管保費幾乎是基本保障的兩倍。)

meaning:
n. 競爭者；對手
vt. 與……匹敵；與……競爭
example: The two cafes are rivals, yet their owners borrow sugar from each other. (這兩家咖啡店是競爭對手，但老闆們還是會互相借糖。)

meaning: adj. 足夠的；適當的
example: The camp still lacks adequate shelter, even though winter temperatures there regularly fall well below freezing at night. (營地仍缺乏足夠的住所，儘管那裡冬季夜間氣溫經常降到遠低於冰點。)

meaning: n. 管；管狀物；（顏料等）軟管
example: The artist carefully squeezed the last small tube of paint, producing just enough faint blue for the sky. (畫家仔細擠出最後一小管顏料，剛好調出足夠畫天空的淡藍色。)

meaning:
v. 登上；爬上；安裝
n. 山；支架；底座
example: They slowly mounted the last steep section just as the sun rose. (太陽升起時，他們慢慢登上最後一段陡坡。)

meaning: n. 恢復；康復；復原
example: Her recovery after the operation was slow, but she returned to work in June. (她手術後的恢復很慢，但六月就回去工作了。)

meaning: n. 差距；邊緣；利潤；頁邊空白
example: The home team still won by a narrow margin, despite missing two of their best players through injury. (地主隊雖然有兩名最佳球員因傷缺陣，仍以些微差距獲勝。)

meaning:
n. 朋友；同伴；配偶
v. 交配；使成對
example: An old mate at work lent me his small van, which saved me the whole cost of hiring one. (一位工作上的老朋友把他的小廂型車借我，省下了我租車的全部費用。)

meaning: v. 欽佩；欣賞；仰慕
example: I admire her patience when she explains difficult ideas to new staff. (我很欽佩她向新員工解釋困難概念時的耐心。)

meaning:
n. 手勢；姿態；表示
v. 打手勢；示意
example: She made a small gesture with two fingers, quietly signalling to the waiter that the bill was ready. (她用兩根手指做了個小手勢，悄悄示意服務生帳單可以送來了。)

meaning: n. 階梯；樓梯的一級
example: She carried the heavy box up the stairs to the second floor. (她把沉重的箱子搬上樓梯到二樓。)

meaning: n. 奴隸；受奴役者
example: The slaves on the cotton plantation were finally freed at the end of the long civil war. (漫長的內戰結束後，棉花園裡的奴隸終於獲得自由。)

meaning:
n. 形式；格式；版式
vt. 編排格式；格式化
example: The format of the radio programme changed last year, attracting younger listeners while losing some loyal older ones. (這個廣播節目的形式去年改變，吸引了較年輕的聽眾，卻流失一些忠實的年長聽眾。)

meaning: n. 誘因；刺激；獎勵
example: Tax breaks provide a strong incentive for companies to invest in research. (減稅為企業投資研究提供強烈誘因。)

meaning: n. 顧問；諮詢師；專科醫師
example: The senior consultant immediately recommended surgery, but the cautious patient asked for a second opinion before finally agreeing. (資深顧問醫師立刻建議手術，但謹慎的病人要求第二意見後才終於同意。)

meaning: n. 赤字；不足；缺陷
example: The city faces a budget deficit of nearly forty million dollars this year. (這座城市今年面臨將近四千萬美元的預算赤字。)

meaning:
n. 房屋抵押貸款；抵押
v. 抵押（房產）
example: They took out a mortgage to buy a small house near the school. (他們申請房貸，買了一棟學校附近的小房子。)

meaning:
adj. 抽象的；理論的
n. 摘要；概要
vt. 提取；抽取；使抽象化
example: The painting is abstract, so viewers read many different things into it. (這幅畫是抽象的，所以觀者會看出許多不同的意涵。)

meaning: adj. 實驗性的；試驗中的
example: The treatment is still experimental and has not yet been approved for general use. (這種療法仍是實驗性的，尚未獲准普遍使用。)

meaning: n. 建築；建築風格；建築學
example: The traditional architecture of the desert town uses thick walls and small windows to keep rooms naturally cool. (這座沙漠城鎮的傳統建築風格採用厚牆和小窗，讓室內自然涼爽。)

meaning: vt. 擁有；具有；持有
example: Few candidates possess both the technical knowledge and the communication skills required. (很少有應徵者同時具備所需的技術知識和溝通能力。)

meaning:
n. 對手；反對者
adj. 對立的；反對的
example: Opponents of the plan argue that the new road will cut through a park used by hundreds of children. (這項計畫的反對者主張，新道路將穿過一座數百名兒童使用的公園。)

meaning: adj. 熱衷的；渴望的；敏銳的
example: She is keen to learn new skills and rarely turns down extra work. (她熱衷學習新技能，很少拒絕額外工作。)

meaning: n. 演化；進化；逐步發展
example: The exhibition clearly explains the evolution of birds from small feathered dinosaurs. (展覽清楚說明鳥類如何從小型有羽毛恐龍演化而來。)

meaning: prep. 對；與……相比；對抗
example: The exhibition clearly compares traditional versus modern building methods, displaying simple old tools and materials side by side. (展覽清楚比較傳統與現代建築工法，把簡單的舊工具和材料並排展示。)

meaning:
v. 爆裂；突然爆發；猛衝
n. 爆發；迸發；一陣
example: An old water pipe burst during the night and flooded the basement. (一條老舊水管在夜裡爆裂，淹了地下室。)

meaning: n. 習俗；慣例；海關（常作 customs）
example: It is a local custom to offer guests tea as soon as they arrive. (客人一到就奉茶，是當地的習俗。)

meaning: v. 翻譯；轉化；導致
example: The heavy investment did not translate into clear profit, and the company closed two factories within a year. (大筆投資並未轉化為明顯利潤，公司在一年內關閉了兩座工廠。)

meaning: adj. 明顯不同的；清楚的；獨特的
example: There is a distinct difference between the two proposals on housing policy. (這兩項住宅政策提案有明顯的差異。)

meaning: adj. 粗糙的；崎嶇的；艱難的；大約的
example: The path was rough and uneven, so walkers needed strong waterproof boots. (那條小路崎嶇不平，行人需要穿堅固的防水靴。)

meaning: n. 手術；外科；診所（英）
example: She needs surgery on her shoulder and will be off work for a month. (她的肩膀需要動手術，將有一個月不能上班。)

meaning: n. 實驗室；研究室
example: The laboratory tests confirmed that the well water was safe to drink. (實驗室檢驗證實井水可以安全飲用。)

meaning: n. 實驗室；研究室（lab 為簡稱）
example: The laboratory is equipped with instruments for analysing air and water samples. (這間實驗室配備了分析空氣與水樣本的儀器。)

meaning:
adj. 雙胞胎的；成對的
n. 雙胞胎之一；一對相似物
example: Her twin sister lives in the same street and they meet for coffee almost every day. (她的雙胞胎姊妹住在同一條街，兩人幾乎每天一起喝咖啡。)

meaning: n. 雞；雞肉
example: The chicken was roasted with fresh herbs and served with steamed rice. (雞肉和新鮮香草一起烤，搭配白飯上桌。)

meaning:
n. 混亂；凌亂；困境
v. 弄亂；弄髒；惹麻煩
example: The kitchen was a mess after the children tried to bake a cake. (孩子們試著烤蛋糕後，廚房一團亂。)

meaning: v. 適應；改編；改造
example: They carefully adapted the old barn into a bright studio, keeping the wooden beams and adding large windows. (他們仔細地把老穀倉改建成明亮的工作室，保留木樑並加裝大窗戶。)

meaning: n. 學者；獎學金獲得者
example: The young scholar argued that the letters were forged, based on careful analysis of the paper. (這位年輕學者根據對紙張的仔細分析，主張這些信件是偽造的。)

meaning: adj. 發瘋的；生氣的；瘋狂的
example: The noise from the machines was so loud that it nearly drove him mad. (機器發出的噪音太大，幾乎把他逼瘋。)

meaning: n. 治療；療法；心理治療
example: Speech therapy helped the young boy speak clearly again after his accident. (語言治療幫助這名小男孩在意外後重新清楚說話。)

meaning: adj. 頻繁的；常見的
example: Frequent hand washing remains one of the simplest ways to stop infections spreading through a busy household. (勤洗手仍是防止感染在忙碌家庭中傳播的最簡單方法之一。)

meaning: adj. 富有的；富裕的
example: The wealthy family quietly opened their large garden to the public, raising much-needed money for a local hospice. (這個富裕家庭悄悄把大花園開放給大眾，為當地安寧療護機構籌募急需的經費。)

meaning: n. 日誌；日記；期刊
example: She kept a detailed daily travel journal, recording small observations that later became the basis of her novel. (她詳細記錄每日旅途見聞，這些細微觀察後來成為她小說的基礎。)

meaning: n. 作品；作文；構成；成分
example: The composition blends local traditional melodies with electronic sounds, which surprises young audiences expecting a purely classical piece. (這首樂曲融合當地傳統旋律與電子音效，讓原本期待純古典作品的年輕觀眾感到驚訝。)

meaning: n. 紙巾；組織；薄層
example: She took a paper tissue from her bag and wiped her eyes quietly. (她從包包裡拿出一張面紙，默默擦了擦眼睛。)

meaning:
n. 中風；一擊；筆畫；划水動作
vt. 輕撫；撫摸
example: Her grandfather made a full recovery after suffering a mild stroke last spring. (她祖父去年春天輕微中風後完全康復。)

meaning:
v. 閃光；閃現；突然展示
n. 閃光；閃現；瞬間
example: A sudden flash of lightning lit the whole valley for a second. (一道突如其來的閃電，把整個山谷照亮了一秒。)

meaning: n. 公平；公正；股權；資產淨值
